mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever noticed how change often tiptoes into our lives—sometimes so quietly, you barely realize it's there until everything feels just a little bit different? Welcome to a journey where we get to explore those subtle shifts together. In Corners: Voices on Change, Amy Lou Jenkins brings us right into the heart of transformation, showing us how it weaves through both our personal stories and the world around us. Through a rich tapestry of voices and perspectives, this collection invites us to see change not just as something that happens to us, but as a force that shapes our identities, our relationships, and our communities. Sometimes, it’s triggered by loss or hope—or maybe it’s just the slow passing of time. No matter the cause, what really stands out is how people find their way through these shifting landscapes, facing challenges and discovering unexpected beauty along the way. As we move forward together, you’ll start to notice the connections between these voices—the universal threads that tie us all together when everything around us is in motion. We’ll share moments of vulnerability and resilience, and you’ll be invited to reflect on how change has quietly shaped your own life too. So, let’s step into this mosaic of lived experiences and discover the quiet revolutions happening right in the corners of our everyday lives.
